column1: # Generic verification checks. Fields are separated by single TAB characters.
# Lines starting with # are comments; lines starting with @ are settings.
# id
# program and arguments are an argument array, never a shell string. Each check must
# assert a real outcome: exit 0 only when the behaviour was proven. An unconfigured
# project is BLOCKED, never PASS.
# PFI check exit codes: 0 PASS, 1 FAIL, 2 BLOCKED, 3 BLOCKED_BY_ENDPOINT_SECURITY, 4 NOT RUN (opt-in), 5 CRASH (FAIL).
# Opt-ins (environment, set only deliberately): PFI_GATE_NATIVE_HARNESS=allow after an authorized security
# review of the compiled C# harness; PFI_GATE_INSTALLED_COM=allow to exercise the live installation;
# PFI_GATE_NATIVE_RECLASSIFIED=<sha256> only after the security owner reclassified that exact blocked build.
@project
@version
@platforms
@delivery_scope
# c-0001 deterministic PowerShell suite, files\tests\Invoke-Tests.ps1 (C# harness launch withheld by default; owned by c-0002)
# c-0002 compiled C# broker harness, x64 and x86: builds once per input set into cache/native-harness and reuses it;
# launches only with PFI_GATE_NATIVE_HARNESS=allow (otherwise BLOCKED_BY_ENDPOINT_SECURITY, withheld)
# c-0003 Phase 0 chooser/Reset/Repair/Uninstall diagnostics: disposable fixtures, isolated registry roots
# c-0004 optional, opt-in: installed x64 COM dispatch smoke against the live installation
# c-0005 public distribution: exactly ten tracked colour ICOs, no personal ICO staged
# c-0006 scripts\verify.ps1: authoritative project verifier (suite again, required files, root layout, parse, ICOs, docs, security scan, diff --check)
# c-0007 native verification infrastructure: outcome classification, process capture, c-0002/c-0004 wrappers with stub
# runners, harness build cache in a disposable root (compile only), blocked-binary launch guard. Launches no harness.
# c-0008 housekeeping helper safeguards (helpers/Remove-GateOutputs.ps1) on a disposable fake outputs tree; a dry run
# against the real outputs folder must delete nothing.
# c-0009 Shell-built static menu (Phase 0B): registers the product menu under GUID-named HKCU test keys through Register-PfiContextMenu,
# neutralizes every command (unregistered CLSID, non-existent path), builds the menu with SHCreateDefaultContextMenu from those keys only
# and asserts what the Shell exposes at each inventory size, through expansion and shrinkage. Re-measures the entry budget. Launches nothing.
# c-0010 Phase 0A maintenance reliability: runs the INSTALLED dispatcher (Repair/Uninstall) as real separate processes against disposable
# install copies with GUID-named HKCU test roots; dialogs are recorded, not shown. Damaged icons, damaged runtime, timeouts, abandoned and concurrent locks.
# Phase 0A.1: also through the registered normal-mode command (wscript.exe + installed launcher), watching for console or Windows Terminal windows.
